sloka: द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुति: ।एका गर्भविनाशाय सपत्न्यै सगरं ददौ ॥ २.११०.१७॥
transliteration: dve cāsya bhārye garbhiṇyau babhūvaturiti śruti: ।ekā garbhavināśāya sapatnyai sagaraṁ dadau ॥ 2.110.17॥

translations.english: Although king Asita engaged all of them in a battle, he was (defeated and) driven into exile. He retired to a delightful, tall mountain and lived a life of contentment of a sage.
